```lean
intro h_mono
constructor
· intro h_iso
  have h_snd_iso : CategoryTheory.IsIso c.snd := h_iso
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.isIso_snd_of_mono_of_isLimit
  exact hc
  exact h_mono
· intro h_snd_iso
  have h_snd_iso' : CategoryTheory.IsIso c.snd := h_snd_iso
  have h_fst_iso : CategoryTheory.IsIso c.fst :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.isIso_fst_of_mono_of_isLimit
      hc (by infer_instance)
  have h_fst_eq_snd : c.fst = c.snd :=
    CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone.fst_eq_snd_of_mono_eq
      (by infer_instance)
  rw [h_fst_eq_snd]
  exact h_snd_iso'
```
